# CUJ SLO catalog

Generated from `slo/slos.yaml` and the CUJ map `slo/cuj-map.example.yaml` (made 2026-11-13T00:00:00Z by cuj-discovery/0.0.0-example, Online Boutique v0.10.7, 20 runs per case; a service is critical when the journey fails in at least 50 % of runs with it broken). Design: [docs/slo/slo-design.md](../../docs/slo/slo-design.md). Do not edit this file; edit the inputs and run `make slo-generate`.

Every SLO uses a rolling 28d window. Budgets are the share of events (or minutes) that may be bad in that window.

## Alert tiers

Each tier pages or opens a ticket when the burn rate is above the threshold over both windows.

| Tier | Severity | Burn rate above | Long window | Short window | Budget spent in the long window | Signals |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| fast | page | 13.44 | 1h | 5m | 2 % | prober, mesh, synthetics |
| medium | page | 5.6 | 6h | 30m | 5 % | prober, mesh, synthetics |
| slow | ticket | 2.8 | 24h | 2h | 10 % | prober, mesh, synthetics |

Plus one `CUJ <id>: prober no data` policy per journey (page) after 10m without prober data.
Every Cloud Monitoring policy carries the user labels `cuj`, `signal`, `sli`, `alert` (`burn-rate` or `no-data`), `burn` (tier name, or `none`), `severity` (`page` or `ticket`) and `generator=slo-gen`.

| `prober-latency` | successful prober steps (home, product) under 500 ms | 95 % | 5 % of successful steps over the threshold | `mamori:cuj_prober_latency:ratio_rate5m{cuj="browse"}` |
| `mesh-availability` | minutes in which the product of the critical services' success ratios meets the target | 99.5 % | 201 bad 1m windows | `mamori:cuj_mesh_availability:ratio_rate2m{cuj="browse"}` |
| `mesh-latency` | minutes in which every critical service has at least the target share of requests under 500 ms | 95 % | 2016 bad 1m windows | `mamori:cuj_mesh_latency:ratio_rate2m{cuj="browse"}` |
| Datadog `slo_browse_synthetics_runs` | synthetics runs passed (7d, 30d) | 99.5 % | 0.5 % of runs | n/a |
